name: Marquette County, MI
findings: Marquette County has 309 nonprofit organizations. 133 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 111 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marquette County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do health care organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Marquette County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
